'''Tschel''' was a [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was [[Imperial officer/Legends|military officer]] in the [[Imperial Military/Legends|military forces]] of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]]. Tschel had characteristics of former [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] personnel who came of age after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].

==Biography==
By [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], Tschel held the rank of [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]], and was assigned as a bridge officer aboard the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']], then serving as the [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]] of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] himself. In the eyes of the flagship's [[Captain/Legends|captain]], [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]], Tschel was absurdly young to hold such an important post, with a lack of experience and self-control for which his training and enthusiasm could not compensate&mdash;but also all too typical of the young volunteers and conscripts who now made up the bulk of the Starfleet's front-line forces, and hardly to be blamed for his own lack of combat experience.

The subsequent [[Thrawn campaign|campaign]] against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] tempered and hardened Tschel and other young officers like him, but little is known of his service over the subsequent decade after the [[Battle of Bilbringi (9 ABY)|Battle of Bilbringi]].

[[19 ABY/Legends|Ten years later]], Tschel served as a bridge officer aboard the ''Chimaera'' with the rank of [[Major/Legends|Major]] under Captain [[Ardiff]].<ref name="SotP" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tschel first appeared in the [[1991]] novel ''[[Heir to the Empire]]'' by [[Timothy Zahn]]. According to Zahn, Tschel was designed to show the slipping quality of Imperial personnel since the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] and to contrast with the competence shown by his superior, Captain Pellaeon.<ref name="20th Anniversary">''[[Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition]]''</ref>
